text:
Priya: Quick sync - AtlasGrid agreed to a short customer spotlight + a 20-min webinar. Need final quote, screenshot of the dashboard, and legal clearance. Target publish: Wed May 5.

Marco (AtlasGrid): Happy to go ahead. We can do a screenshot but need to blur customer names in the UI. Quote draft: "AtlasGrid saw a 45% drop in batch inference latency after moving to Redwood."

Jordan: Nice. Rina, can you wrap that quote into the hero line and write a 2-sentence lead?

Rina: On it. Will also draft webinar CTA copy.

Denise (Legal): Heads-up 6A7 - we can't publish percent improvements tied to a named customer's contracts without explicit data release clause. Either (a) AtlasGrid provides a short data-release sign-off or (b) we convert to qualitative language like "significant drop".

Marco (AtlasGrid): We can sign a short release for that percent. I'll route to our legal. ETA EOD tomorrow.

Priya: Great. Two operational asks: (1) Alex - can you take the high-res screenshot and export with sensitive fields blurred? (2) Zoe - what lead tag do we use?

Alex: Yes, will capture the screen during the call and produce a blurred export. Need AtlasGrid to confirm which fields to obscure.

Zoe: Use `lead-src=atlas-spotlight` and route to midmarket-AE queue. I'll create a Slack alert to sales when the post goes live.

Cam: Webinar logistics: 20 min + live Q&A. Record and make on-demand behind reg wall. Want a co-presenter from Product. Marco, who from AtlasGrid will present?

Marco (AtlasGrid): Our Head of ML, Lina, can join. She's slightly camera-shy; audio + slides ok.

Rina: Noted. Draft slide outline: 1) Challenge 2) Approach with Redwood 3) Results (percent phrase only if release is signed) 4) 5-min demo screenshot 5) CTA.

Priya: If legal signs off on the percent, we'll use it in the hero and slide 3. Otherwise we default to: "substantial reduction in latency."

Denise (Legal): If AtlasGrid signs the release with explicit permission to publish the 45% number, legal is fine. Also request: no raw cost or contract terms in slides.

Marco (AtlasGrid): I'll send the signed release and mark which UI elements to blur.

Alex: Upload target folder: drive:/marketing/atlasgrid/ -> I'll add a `to-blur.txt` with coordinates once Marco confirms.

Zoe: Webinar registration form question: include a dropdown for company size so AEs can triage. Also add `utm_source=atlas_spotlight`.

Rina: Copy note: let's A/B test two subject lines for the email announce. I can prepare both.

Priya: Timeline check: Interview + screenshots this Thu, slides ready Mon, legal sign-off Tue. If any of these slip we push publish.

Marco (AtlasGrid): Interview confirmed Thu 11:00am PT. I'll bring Lina and the signed release.

Cam: I'll book Zoom, record settings on, please enable registration.

Denise (Legal): One more: include a one-line attribution format: "[Name], [Role], AtlasGrid" for quotes. Please don't use full job descriptions.

Rina: Got it. Draft quote variants: (A) "AtlasGrid saw a 45% drop in batch inference latency after moving to Redwood." (B) "We saw a substantial drop in batch inference latency after migrating to Redwood."

Priya: Perfect. Action items: Marco - signed release + blur list; Alex - screenshot exports; Rina - draft hero + email variants; Zoe - lead tags + reg form; Cam - Zoom & recording; Denise - legal review of final assets; Jordan - publish checklist.

Jordan: I'll make the checklist and set reminders. Will post final go/no-go 24h before publish.

Marco (AtlasGrid): Release sent and signed. Uploading now: https://atlasdrive.internal/releases/annex.pdf

Alex: Received. I'll upload `dashboard-blurred.png` and `dashboard-raw-for-legal.png` to the folder after redraw.

Denise (Legal): Reviewed the blurred screenshot. Approved. No contract specifics visible.

Priya: All green. Webinar scheduled, assets incoming, legal cleared. We'll run the A/B subject test on the email and report back on CTR.

Zoe: I'll wire the lead routing and Slack alert. Tagging Sam in Sales to standby.

Sam: Standing by. Prioritize MQLs from this campaign.

Priya: Thanks team - closing thread once the publish checklist is live. :rocket:
